Glasswork.Preview: real Dear ImGui rendered headless to PNG, with scripted input.

  --scene <name>          what to draw, one of imgui, glass, widgets, widgets-states, surface, shell, gallery, charts, data, inspector, effects-ambient, effects-loaders, effects-particles, effects-motion, game-kit, game-kit-world, theme-designer, theme-designer-shape, theme-designer-glass, theme-designer-audit, theme-designer-accent, theme-designer-library, forms, productivity, showcase-hero, showcase-looks, showcase-looks-new, showcase-glass, showcase-dashboard, showcase-effects, showcase-game-kit, showcase-forms, showcase-palette, showcase-reorder, showcase-designer, showcase-first-window (required unless --selftest or --compare)
  --out <png|dir>         where to save the last frame (default: <scene>.png); with --compare, the directory for the actuals and diffs
  --size WxH              display size in pixels (default: 1280x800)
  --frames <n>            frames to run before saving (default: 3; a script extends it)
  --backdrop <png>        an image behind the scene instead of the procedural one
  --warp                  render on the WARP software rasterizer
  --adapter <index|name>  render on that DXGI adapter, an index from --list-adapters or a part of its name, instead of the default one
  --script <file>         frame-numbered input lines: move, click, down, up, wheel, key, text, shot
  --look <family>         the Look the widget scenes draw with, one of neutral, liquid, eorzea, minimal, high-contrast, retro, classic, clear-blue, clear-grey, clear-green, clear-pink, aurora, catppuccin, nord (default: neutral)
  --light                 draw the widget scenes in the light variant of the Look
  --reduce-motion         draw the widget scenes with reduced motion: springs snap, the glass light stays still
  --contrast              draw the widget scenes with increased contrast and reduced transparency: opaque fills with borders, no translucent surface
